notes.title: V0.1.3.3
notes.notes:
1.Support keyboard set
(You can change the set in different situation)
2.Support key + mouse hotkey
3.Support Caps-Lock key
4.Support hotkey to turn Silent Mode ON/OFF
5.Upgrade Nett library to V0.9.0
6.Keyboard(Normal-Layout) won't response to mouse anymore 
7.Move "Tab" key to normal tab
8.Can select set via NotifyIcon
9.Fix bugs
-Side-Layout hotkey show
-Make ←(Left) and ←(Backspace) more clear
-Localization (zh-CHT)["托盤"] -> ["通知區"]
-Other optimizations

Thanks for using my software.
